module_title: Introduction to Digestion, Respiration, and Circulation
introduction: The human body is a miraculous machine. At this level, we understand how we extract energy from food (Digestion), how we obtain oxygen to burn that food (Respiration), and how everything is transported to every corner of the body (Circulation).

core_concepts.title: Digestive System
core_concepts.description:
Digestion is the process of breaking down complex food into simpler absorbable forms. 
Pathway: Mouth $\rightarrow$ Esophagus (Food pipe) $\rightarrow$ Stomach $\rightarrow$ Small Intestine $\rightarrow$ Large Intestine. 
Crucial Fact: The process of digestion 'begins in the Mouth' itself.

core_concepts.title: Respiratory System
core_concepts.description:
Breathing is just inhaling and exhaling. 'Respiration' is the actual burning of glucose with oxygen inside the cells to release energy (ATP). 
Pathway: Nose $\rightarrow$ Trachea (Windpipe) $\rightarrow$ Lungs. 
Alveoli: Tiny, balloon-like structures inside the lungs where the actual exchange of Oxygen ($O_2$) and Carbon Dioxide ($CO_2$) takes place.

core_concepts.title: Circulatory System
core_concepts.description:
This is the body's 'Transport System'. Its main organ is the 'Heart', which acts as a motor pump. 
1. Arteries: Blood vessels that carry 'Oxygenated (Pure) blood' AWAY from the heart to the body parts. 
2. Veins: Blood vessels that bring 'Deoxygenated (Impure) blood' carrying $CO_2$ back TO the heart.

important_entities.name: Small Intestine
important_entities.key_fact: The main hub of digestion and absorption
important_entities.significance: The 'complete digestion' of food and the 'absorption' of nutrients into the blood occurs strictly in the Small Intestine. The Large Intestine's main job is simply to absorb excess water, not to digest food.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Ultimate Artery and Vein Exception
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: All arteries carry pure blood, BUT the **'Pulmonary Artery'** is the ONLY exception; it carries impure blood from the heart to the lungs. Similarly, the **'Pulmonary Vein'** is the ONLY vein that carries pure oxygenated blood (from the lungs back to the heart).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Arteries ALWAYS carry blood 'Away' from the heart.

exam_strategy_tips: A highly repeated SSC/Railway question: 'Which enzyme is present in human saliva that begins the digestion of starch?' Answer: Ptyalin (Salivary Amylase).
